stale.title: Stale-assertion check
stale.ok: Stale-assertion check: OK (scanned %(count)d documents; retired names: %(declared)s)
stale.ledger_empty: ledger is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard): first check whether measure() is broken
stale.no_docs: not a single living-state document was scanned — empty input is not a pass (zero-value guard)
stale.ledger_missing: facts ledger missing (%(name)s). Run python3 zreflect/facts.py first to measure once.
stale.retired_rule_off: R2 (retired names): REFLECT_RETIRED is not configured ⇒ this rule is not enabled (to enable: REFLECT_RETIRED=name1,name2)
stale.age_rule_off: staleness age: REFLECT_STALE_DAYS is not configured ⇒ this rule is not enabled (to enable: REFLECT_STALE_DAYS=days)
stale.sha_no_facts: %(name)s:%(lineno)d sha assertion has no source: the ledger has **no sha-type fact at all**; measure it into the ledger first (with a replay command), then cite it
stale.sha_unsourced: %(name)s:%(lineno)d sha assertion has no source: `%(actual)s` is not in the ledger — rewrite it as a [[key]] reference, or give a verifiable source (delivery package name / backticked commit sha). Note: the word "history" is **not** a source (issue #25)
stale.measured_at_missing: `%(key)s` has a missing or unparsable measured_at — the staleness criterion cannot be evaluated (unreadable is stated, never guessed)
stale.too_old: `%(key)s` has not been measured for %(days)d days (threshold %(threshold)d days) — re-measure and pass `--accept-changes` explicitly
stale.retired_name: %(name)s:%(lineno)d retired name `%(entry)s` appears in living state — either it is not retired, or this line carries a history marker
